implementation: Verified created worktree registration through direct and manager-owned creation; captured destination and precise shared metadata permissions, first status publication and recents, without workspace adoption
Accepted Git creation retained across registration failure and late cancellation; explicit registration-only retry, owned process/scope/Quit drainage and retired publication fencing
Shared native reference popup/revision focus delivery across attachment, enablement and sheet completion; one-shot and retired-window guards
Captured Worktree form bindings, options and picker callbacks refuse stale drafts and owned/retired states
Separate new-picker admission from exact owned-result admission in Branch/Tag and Worktree; all five shared coordinator consumers reviewed
Reference-browser Cancel preserves drafts, tracking/override and focus counters without a selection read or defaulting

retained_failures.cause: Actual accepted result produced focusRequest=0. Parent new-picker admission was also used for its already-owned picker result, refusing acceptance before selection/focus publication. Shared native control focus checks had passed; exact firstResponder assertion retained.

Real direct and manager-created worktree persistence passed. Later injected Error conformed to CustomStringConvertible but supplied no localizedDescription; diagnostic-string assertion was invalid. Injection now uses NSError with explicit NSLocalizedDescriptionKey; all success/warning/mutation assertions retained.

daemon.old_hosted_failure: Generated source line included prepended import; failure was combined owner-close assertion before the following stopped-status assertion. Waiting only for activeOperations=0 did not await deferred onClosed.
daemon.corrected_fixture: Exact owner pending work plus single close callback; held worker cancellation, duplicate requests, warning Abort, forced-close drain and retired output guards.

affected_repair_checkpoint.retained_fixture_failure: The repaired acceptance and native focus passed, but a new consumed-focus assertion assumed SwiftUI TextField exposes an NSTextField subview. It now uses an explicit private native edit target in the same owned window and retains the exact no-focus-steal assertion. Only the picker fixture repeated; no app rebuild, Daemon, registration, Core or documentation-suite rerun.

core: unchanged; no Core suite run for native/fixture changes
remaining: Signed/physical Finder grants and badges for new worktrees
Physical keyboard, VoiceOver, both-appearance source layout acceptance
Intel/minimum-macOS execution and wider port/distribution gates
final_passes: Creation picker family with real private Git creations, original exact firstResponder assertions and shared native focus lifecycle
Finder worktree registration through direct and actual manager dispatch, durable metadata grants/cache/recents, accepted failure/retry/late cancellation and forced retirement
Daemon progress/questions/output/real loopback lifecycle from initial grouped checkpoint
cleanup: All owned receivers reaped by their runners and independently absent; private preferences/repos/owned windows closed. No installed app launched.
validation_policy: One batch checkpoint, then only source-failure-affected Debug/picker/registration checks and one fixture-only picker recheck. Passing Daemon and Core suites not repeated; Core unchanged.
